subject: UpdateChannel默认配置值修正
patch:
--- mRemoteV1/Properties/Settings.settings
@@ -504,7 +504,7 @@
       <Value Profile="(Default)">False</Value>
     </Setting>
     <Setting Name="UpdateChannel" Type="System.String" Scope="User">
-      <Value Profile="(Default)">release</Value>
+      <Value Profile="(Default)">Stable</Value>
     </Setting>
     <Setting Name="ThemeName" Type="System.String" Scope="User">
       <Value Profile="(Default)" />
--- mRemoteV1/app.config
@@ -706,6 +706,7 @@
   <applicationSettings>
     <mRemoteNG.Settings>
         <setting name="UpdateAddress" serializeAs="String">
+            <!-- <value>https://mremoteng.org/</value> -->
             <value>https://gcstoragedownload.blob.core.windows.net/download/mRemoteNG/</value>
         </setting>
         <setting name="SupportedUICultures" serializeAs="String">
@@ -732,4 +733,7 @@
        </assemblyBinding>
   
   </runtime>
-<startup><supportedRuntime version="v4.0" sku=".NETFramework,Version=v4.6"/></startup></configuration>
\ No newline at end of file
+  <startup>
+    <supportedRuntime version="v4.0" sku=".NETFramework,Version=v4.6"/>
+  </startup>
+</configuration>
\ No newline at end of file

triage.rationale: Tweaks UpdateChannel default in legacy mRemoteV1 config. Our fork removed update channels entirely (#136, 8fa29117e/3e9f8a7bc) — GitHub-releases-only. Obsolete.
